title: populus macrocarpa
intro: Populus macrocarpa, commonly known as Bigtooth Aspen, is a deciduous tree species native to the mountainous regions of western North America. The bark of this plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Populus macrocarpa bark include soothing and calming effects on the skin, reducing swelling and pain, and aiding in the treatment of wounds and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents present in the bark of this plant include salicin, a compound similar to aspirin, and flavonoids such as quercetin, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
